dct_description_sm:
Do you have a sign you want to post for a garage/craft sale, dance, or other community event? Brampton has over 100 black plastic sign sleeves on street light and traffic poles. Any signs not posted on a sign sleeve may be subject to removal and a fine under the City’s Sign By-Law.

Majority of the advertising signs that you see posted on light poles, street signs and boulevards are illegal. To report such nuisance signs to the City and have an officer dispatched to remove it, call 3-1-1 or email the location details to enforcement@brampton.ca. You can also use the PingStreet app’s “Report a Problem” feature to alert us of the by-law infraction.

When posting a sign on one of these sleeves, use the following guidelines:

You can only post one sign per sign sleeve
Size cannot exceed 36 cm x 43 cm (14 in x 17 in)
What you put up, you must take down
Display the posting date on the sign
